content:
Cost Explorer is a free tool that you can use to view your spending data for the past 13 months.
Analyzing this data helps you identify trends and understand if RIs ﬁt your use case. If you already
have RIs, you can group by Purchase Option and show amortized costs to compare that spending
to your spending for On-Demand Instances. You can also set usage budgets to make sure you are
taking full advantage of your reservations. For more information, see Analyzing Your Costs with
Cost Explorer in the AWS Billing User Guide.
